title: Annotatio III §.IX: Form in Hoc est Corpus meum / Hic est sanguis — priest’s enunciation confects Transsubstantiation
pass_a_gloss: In the Enunciation of Christ’s words: This is My Body, This is My blood, or, This is the cup of My blood — inasmuch as by the Enunciation of those words, made by the Priest, the Sacrament of Transsubstantiation is confected.
pass_b_english: Form = enunciation of Christ’s words: Hoc est Corpus meum; Hic est sanguis meus; or Hic est calix sanguinis mei.
By the priest’s speaking those words, they say, the Sacrament of Transsubstantiation is confected.
source_text: In Enunciatione verborum Christi: Hoc est Corpus meum, Hic est sanguis meus, vel, Hic est calix sanguinis mei, utpote quorum verborum Enuntiatione, à Sacerdote facta, Sacramentum Transsubstantiationis conficiatur.

lemmas.gloss: the Sacrament of Transsubstantiation is confected
